overview_description.description: Firecrawl converts websites into clean, AI-ready data through a unified API. It provides functionality to crawl entire websites or scrape individual pages, returning outputs in markdown, structured data (JSON), HTML, screenshots, and more. It handles dynamic content, JavaScript-rendered pages, proxies, rate limits, and caching behind the scenes to simplify integration for developers. It supports integrations with popular AI frameworks and tools, including LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Zapier, offering flexible usage across different environments.

product.name: Scrape API
product.description: An API that extracts clean, LLM-ready data from individual web pages in formats like Markdown, JSON, and screenshots.

product.name: Crawl API
product.description: An API that collects data from all accessible pages of a website, even without a sitemap, providing structured data for each page.

product.name: Search API
product.description: An API that searches the web and scrapes full content from search results with a single call.

product.name: Extract API
product.description: An API endpoint for structured extraction of specific data elements from web content, priced separately from scraping and crawling.
